title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Fun in a hard season
hook: Your team has not won much this season. Are they still having fun?
intro: Kids still show up every week.
statement: A hard season can still be a good one.
q1: Do you shift focus to fun and small goals —
q2: or keep pushing toward a win?
q3: Why do your players keep coming back?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But kids keep playing
t2: when the season is about more than the record.
cta: Coaches — how do you keep it fun?
ctaLines: Small goals. Silly games. Celebrate effort.
Fun first or chase the win?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Your team has not won much this season. Are they still having fun?
The losses pile up. Kids still show up every week.
A hard season can still be a good one.
Focus on fun or keep chasing a win. Both can work.
How do you keep it fun? Share your habit in the comments.
